extract_mpii_dataset: extract MPII dataset annotations from HDF5 file and OpenPose detections into an NPZ file
run_mpii_extract: run mpii_extract to process MPII training data from data/train.h5 and save to output path
create_mpii_train_npz: create an NPZ file with image names, centers, scales, parts, and openpose keypoints from MPII annotations
review_mpii_extract: review the mpii_extract function that reads HDF5 annotations and OpenPose JSON detections for MPII dataset processing
refactor_mpii_extract: refactor mpii_extract to parameterize the hardcoded data/train.h5 annotation file path instead of using a string literal
